title: Programmable synthetic engineering of adaptive microbial cell factories: from amide transforming enzymes to advanced biocatalytic systems.
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦微生物细胞工厂中酰胺转化酶（尤其MTGase）的工程化改造，虽涉及AlphaFold、对接、MD等蛋白质结构计算工具，但核心是合成生物学与生物催化应用，蛋白质结构计算仅为辅助手段，非核心研究对象。
abstract: Microbial cell factories integrate metabolic engineering, synthetic regulation, protein engineering, and computational design to improve catalytic performance and process robustness. Within this landscape, amide transforming enzymes provide diverse functions ranging from nitrogen metabolism and hydrolysis to covalent protein remodeling. This review examines amidases, asparaginases, glutaminases, nitrilases, nitrile hydratases, acylases, and carbamylases, with particular emphasis on microbial transglutaminase (MTGase). MTGase is distinguished by its ability to catalyze covalent epsilon-(gamma-glutamyl) lysine crosslinking through acyl transfer reactions, enabling protein stabilization, molecular assembly, immobilization, and spatial organization of catalytic systems. This review critically examines the transition from classical amide transforming enzymes toward engineered biocatalytic systems and evaluates how MTGase could be leveraged as a protein level control component in microbial cell factories. Experimental developments in MTGase production, structural and protein engineering, synthetic genetic circuits, CRISPR based regulation, metabolic control, nanobiomaterials, and spatial biocatalysis are evaluated alongside computational approaches including AlphaFold assisted structure prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, machine learning guided mutagenesis, and metabolic modeling. Emphasis is placed on experimentally validated outcomes and current limitations. Key unresolved barriers include intracellular off target crosslinking, proteostatic burden, variable crosslink stoichiometry, limited temporal control of MTGase activity, chassis dependence, and industrial scale up. Where direct evidence is lacking, prospective applications are distinguished from established capabilities and corresponding engineering strategies are proposed. Collectively, this review envisions MTGase as a controllable protein level platform for synthetic biology, while defining the evidence, limitations, and experimental requirements needed for its broader application in microbial biotechnology.
abstract_zh: 微生物细胞工厂整合代谢工程、合成调控、蛋白质工程和计算设计，以提升催化性能与过程稳健性。在此背景下，酰胺转化酶提供从氮代谢、水解到共价蛋白质重塑的多种功能。本综述考察酰胺酶、天冬酰胺酶、谷氨酰胺酶、腈水解酶、腈水合酶、酰基转移酶和氨甲酰酶，并特别关注微生物转谷氨酰胺酶 (microbial transglutaminase, MTGase)。MTGase 的独特之处在于其通过酰基转移反应催化共价 epsilon-(gamma-glutamyl) lysine 交联，从而实现蛋白质稳定化、分子组装、固定化及催化系统的空间组织。本综述批判性地审视从经典酰胺转化酶向工程化生物催化系统的转变，并评估 MTGase 如何作为微生物细胞工厂中的蛋白质水平控制组件加以利用。实验进展涵盖 MTGase 生产、结构与蛋白质工程、合成遗传电路、基于 CRISPR 的调控、代谢控制、纳米生物材料及空间生物催化，同时评估计算方法，包括 AlphaFold 辅助结构预测、分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics)、机器学习引导的诱变及代谢建模。重点强调实验验证结果及当前局限性。关键未解决障碍包括细胞内脱靶交联、蛋白质稳态负担、交联化学计量可变性、MTGase 活性时间控制有限、底盘依赖性及工业放大。在缺乏直接证据的情况下，前瞻性应用与既有能力区分开来，并提出相应工程策略。总体而言，本综述设想 MTGase 作为合成生物学中可控的蛋白质水平平台，同时明确其在微生物生物技术中更广泛应用所需的证据、局限性和实验要求。
